      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes concurrent CI container jobs colliding over Docker subnets, improving test infrastructure reliability."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Man page regenerations and template cleanups merely follow the backported changes rather than representing primary documentation work.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation changes are mechanical updates accompanying backported code changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches to `src/policy/fees/estimator_man.cpp` are secondary backport artifacts with no mempool or policy problem addressed.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "The PR does not address mempool or transaction acceptance policy issues."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "No changes to block template construction or mining RPCs.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mining logic is unaffected by this backport batch."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies `src/private_broadcast.cpp` and `src/net_processing.cpp` to fix connection handling for private transaction broadcast.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Ensures all three initial connections are sent when initiating private broadcast and prevents stale retry connections, protecting transaction relay reliability and privacy."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Fixes `bitcoin-cli` client timeout handling when `-rpcclienttimeout=0` is used.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves an issue where running `bitcoin-cli` with `-rpcclienttimeout=0` errors out on macOS and BSD systems due to `select()` failing with `EINVAL`."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies `src/test/fuzz/private_broadcast.cpp` to repair fuzz test state exploration.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes the private broadcast fuzz test which failed to explore state due to hardcoded zero-seeding."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Man page touches for CLI tools are generated updates rather than substantive changes to developer or operator tooling.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Tool behavior is not modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Updates `Sock::Wait` timeout handling in `src/util/sock.cpp`.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Caps socket wait timeout at `INT_MAX` milliseconds in utility socket code to prevent `select()` platform failures on macOS and BSD systems."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches to wallet utility headers and test files are incidental backport includes without functional wallet changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not address wallet correctness or functionality."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,

    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
